name: Rebelde Way
description: Four teenagers at an elite school in Buenos Aires are drawn together by their love of music, despite their differing social and economic backgrounds.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Queen bee Mia pulls a daring stunt. Rebel Marizza dislikes her new school. Ladies’ man Pablo ditches a family trip. Vengeful Manuel begins a mission.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Principal Dunoff and Sonia share a past. Manuel catches the eye of two girls. Naive Luna, tomboy Luján and bragger Guido arrive. Marizza spies a kiss.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Manuel defends nerdy Marcos, and later pumps Felicitas for info. Marizza’s bid for attention backfires. Pablo finds his community service to be scary.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Annoyed by her mom, Marizza plays a mean prank on her. Pilar uses overheard conversations to get revenge. Manuel steals a private moment with Mia.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pablo’s dad makes a scene. Marizza becomes jealous. Manuel makes a deal with Guido, and later runs into Mia’s dad. Another rumor report is published.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Manuel takes his fake romance with Felicitas to the next level to get more info. Marizza is targeted for revenge. Nicolás grows suspicious of Manuel.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sonia and Colucci run into each other. Luna feels like a misfit. Pilar tries to turn Guido against his roomies. Nicolás thinks Manuel is a leech.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mia tries to bring Luna into her clique. Marizza’s friends race to find evidence to exonerate her. Felicitas thinks Luna is trying to steal Manuel.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Pilar learns of a rumor about her father. Colucci finds his face on a tabloid. Mia spies on Manuel. Guido thinks he knows who the rumor reporter is.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Marizza auditions for the dance club. Tomás learns who his secret admirer is. Mia has a startling dream. Manuel helps Felicitas prove her mom wrong.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Pablo's party is a flop. Felicitas wants Manuel and Mia to be pals. Tomás gets another love note and meets the writer. Mia sees a photo of her mom.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Colucci investigates Manuel. Pablo worries Marizza's report is about him. Guido bets he can win over Mia. The dance club's rehearsal is interrupted.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Manuel and Mia have an odd confrontation. Felicitas warns Manuel about a secret society. Tomás asks for Pilar's help. Pablo tries to silence Marizza.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Manuel learns he's the Lodge's next target. Luna leaves the school. Mia catches Vico in a lie. Marizza finds a way to get Manuel to accept charity.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The Lodge threatens Manuel. Luján finds a clue about her sponsor. Marizza plans an escape to her party, where Pablo has a surprise in store for her.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Felicitas embarrasses herself. Marizza is pressured to take the blame for the party. Pablo gets humiliating

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Felicitas is desperate to lose weight. Pablo's dad learns what Tomás did and orders his son to restore the family name. The Lodge picks a new target.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Marcos has a difficult conversation. Manuel urges Felicitas to try out for the new dance club. Pablo gets his pride back. Nicolás receives a warning.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Vico suffers grave consequences due to the rumors about her. Nicolás is traumatized. Marizza's dance team performs an unusual audition routine.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Manuel worries about Felicitas's dependence on him. Pablo coerces Marizza into being his lackey. The psychologist's report troubles Sonia.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Manuel tries a different strategy with Felicitas. Mia plans to protest Vico's punishment. The second psychologist session doesn't go as smoothly.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Marizza helps Mia organize a protest. Pablo's dad gives his son a challenge to prove he dominates Marizza. Nacho gets a job. The Lodge strikes again.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Felicitas's illness brings Mia and Manuel closer. New pupil Joaquín creates a stir among the girls. Colucci thinks Marizza is a bad influence on Mia.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Manuel and Felicitas come to an understanding. Marizza hunts down Joaquín at a nightclub. Manuel finds the Lodge's stash. Mia gets a box of treasures.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Mia finds pages from her mom's diary. Colucci asks Manuel to spy on Mia. Marizza scrambles to find a way out of her lunch date with Pablo's family.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Joaquin plays Mia and Marizza. Colucci finds out that Peter gave Mia her mother's things. Pablo forces Marizza to do an assignment for him. Luna tells Nico she loves him. Pilar finds Pablo's secret.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Marizza's secret is revealed. She has to say goodbye to Nacho. She thinks Pablo did it and decides get his music on the radio as revenge. Mia tells Colucci she's in love with Joaquin. Joaquin plans to be with her and Marizza.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Marizza learns that Pilar exposed Nacho. Hilda the teacher states her opinion on Jews. Nico and Luna date. Mia plans to meet Joaquin. Feli stops her. Lujan is worried about Marcos' health. She corresponds with her guardian.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Pablo's father is mad because of his music. He wants to send him to military academy. Joaquin is mad at Marizza for hiding her mom's identity. Joaquin wants to sleep with Mia. She wants to stop him. Manuel listens to them.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Marizza calls Pablo's mom. She tells him that he won't go to military academy. Manuel makes Joaquin leave Mia. She finds out. She also learns about Joaquin and Marizza's affair.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Nico's ex comes from Israel. Nico denies that is Jewish. Hilda gets an anonymous letter. Mora insists on not sending Pablo to the academy. Marizza tells Marcos that his brother is a drug addict. Mia fights with Manuel.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Colucci argues with Sonia for talking about sex to the class. Luna finds out Joaquin dates Mia and Marizza. Colucci doesn't let Mia date Joaquin. Guido tells Mia about it. Marcos tells Marizza he's killed someone.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Nico's family has intentions about him and Tatiana, his ex. Pablo, Guido and Luna learn that Joaquin dates both Mia and Marizza. Vico goes out with Manuel and invites him to her home. Colucci sends Sonia flowers.
